signals.name: HCLK
signals.description: Master clock for the AHB system. All signal timings are related to the rising edge of HCLK.

signals.name: HRESETn
signals.description: Active-low reset signal. Asserted asynchronously, de-asserted synchronously.

signals.name: HADDR
signals.description: The 32-bit (or larger) system address bus. Driven by the master.

signals.name: HTRANS
signals.description: Indicates the type of the current transfer: IDLE, BUSY, NONSEQ, or SEQ.

signals.name: HSIZE
signals.description: Indicates the size of the transfer (Byte, Halfword, Word, etc.).

signals.name: HBURST
signals.description: Indicates if the transfer forms part of a burst (SINGLE, INCR, WRAP4, etc.).

signals.name: HPROT
signals.description: Provides information about the access (privileged, cacheable, etc.).

signals.name: HWDATA
signals.description: The write data bus, driven by the master during write transfers.

signals.name: HRDATA
signals.description: The read data bus, driven by the slave during read transfers.

signals.name: HREADY
signals.description: Driven by the slave to indicate transfer completion (1) or request wait states (0).

signals.name: HRESP
signals.description: Provides the status of the transfer: OKAY (0) or ERROR (1).

signals.name: HSEL
signals.description: Driven by the decoder to select a specific slave for the transfer.

signals.name: HEXCL
signals.description: AHB5 signal indicating an exclusive access sequence.

signals.name: HEXOKAY
signals.description: AHB5 response from slave indicating exclusive write success.

signals.name: HNONSEC
signals.description: AHB5 signal indicating the TrustZone security level.
